description: Generate a Vedic (sidereal) birth horoscope from birth date, time and place. Returns a summary (ascendant/lagna, Moon and Sun signs, birth nakshatras and padas); the Rashi (D-1) chart in 'rasi_chart' -- the ascendant and the nine grahas (Sun to Ketu), each with sign, degree within the sign, nakshatra and pada, plus the bhava house (equal 30° houses with the ascendant's degree at the middle of house 1, so a graha more than 15° from the ascendant's degree within its sign is one house off the plain sign count) and a retrograde flag for Mars to Saturn (these two only for the default house method and natal settings); the birth panchanga in 'calendar_info'; and the names of the other calculated sections. Call this first; later tools reuse the same cached chart for divisional charts, strengths, dashas and more. Data only -- no interpretation is added.

date.description: Birth date in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. 1985-06-15

gender.description: Optional. A few classical yogas are defined by gender -- Mahabhagya's rule is gender x day/night x odd/even signs. Supply it when known; when omitted those yogas are left out of the result rather than computed against an assumed gender.

latitude.description: Birth-place latitude in decimal degrees, e.g. 13.0827

longitude.description: Birth-place longitude in decimal degrees, e.g. 80.2707

time.description: Birth time in 24h HH:MM:SS format, e.g. 10:30:00

timezone.description: Timezone offset from UTC in hours, e.g. 5.5 for IST

name: generate_horoscope
title: Birth Chart Summary
